name: pipeline-classification

protocol.note: run_pipeline_classification compiles a tiny Metal compute kernel specialized by a function-constant PipelineKeyState axis across a 2x2x2 matrix (PipelineKeyState x MetalDynamicState x ShaderVisibleData). naive-full-permutation creates one MTLComputePipelineState per triple (8 PSOs). vg-stateblock-classification keys the cache only on PipelineKeyState (2 PSOs), treating MetalDynamicState and ShaderVisibleData as encode-time bindings that must hit the cached PSO (6 cache hits, 2 misses). UnsupportedNeedsConversion blocks are rejected rather than silently folded into a key. Scope is compute-only: no render PSO exists in this codebase yet (ADR-030/034).

correctness.oracle: arithmetic: naive_pipeline_count == 8; classified_pipeline_count == 2; cache_misses == 2; cache_hits == 6; classified_pipeline_count < naive_pipeline_count

judgement: StateBlock classification on the existing compute-pipeline creation path reduces the test-matrix PSO count from 8 (naive full permutation) to 2 (PipelineKeyState only), with dynamic/shader-visible axes hitting the classified cache. Per ADR-030 this experiment is a roadmap work item and is implemented, but it is NOT a hard gate for Phase C closure (the catalog Representation gate row lists only E005/E008/E016). Scope boundary (explicit): compute PSO only -- AttachmentFacet/raster PSO classification is out of scope because no render command encoder exists yet.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024/030); no Vulkan pipeline-classification wiring was attempted (no Vulkan hardware reachable on this host)
